snippet.title: Everdark — Release Date Trailer (International)
snippet.description:
Everdark blends old-school boomer-shooter speed with real survival tension.
You can play the demo right now in Steam and the full game lands October 24.

What’s in the trailer / game:
• Fast, agile combat: slides, strafes, clear enemy telegraphs
• Risk/reward loop: reload or push? light or darkness?
• Vampire-themed arsenal, tight arenas, boss teases

Play & follow:
• Play de Demo → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3628490/EVERDARK_Undead_Apocalypse_Demo/?l=english
• Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3324980/EVERDARK_Undead_Apocalypse/
• Participate in the contest by writing your opinion in our discussion forum. → https://steamcommunity.com/app/3324980/discussions/0/554627540143429115/

Credits:
